contexts.text: So far as a man eats the flesh of animals from conscience, so far it is allowable...
Every evil has its bounds... which it is not allowed to go beyond...
It is allowable to relate... AC 2127. AC 2129. AC 2299. AC 2726. AC 4110. AC 4224:2. AC 4249. AC 4279:end. AC 4644. AC 6695.
It is not allowable to mention...
The Lord thought in His childhood whether it is allowable to enter into the doctrine of faith by means of rational things. Signified, Explained.
It is allowable to give only a summary...
He thus does evil as allowable, free, and delightful.
Spirits... who in the life of the body... have persuaded themselves that adulteries are allowable.
He then makes evils allowable...
It is impossible for a man to be saved unless he is allowed to do what is evil, because he is born in evil...
Although they do not commit evils they account them allowable, and thus commit them in spirit, and also in body when it is allowable.
He thinks these evils allowable before God, but not allowable before the world.

The evils that a man thinks allowable are appropriated to him, although he does not commit them, for allowableness in the thought is from the will, for it is consent; wherefore when a man believes any evil to be allowable, he looses the inward bond for it, and is withheld from committing it merely by outward bonds...
Such are the concupiscences of evil, and the evils themselves, with those who in their spirit make evils allowable.
Concupiscences produce evils through their delights; but when evils are believed to be allowable, which takes place from consent of the will and understanding, delights and evils make one.
In proportion as a man confirms evils as allowable he enlarges the court of the reigning love...
Concerning this Fortune... I have been permitted to learn many things which it is not allowable to make known.
All who are in the love of ruling from self-love are in the love of all evils; and if they do not commit them, still in their spirit they believe them allowable...
Man is to examine himself... especially as to what evils he makes allowable in his spirit, and does not account as sins, for these he still commits.
If a man were not allowed to think according to the delights of his life's love he would be man no longer...
Everyone in Hell is allowed to be in his own delight... provided he does not infest good Spirits and Angels... CL 461:4.
Everyone is allowed to ascend into Heaven... From experience.
Common because continually allowed...
Adulteries of the fourth degree are adulteries of the will, which are committed by those who make them allowable and pleasing... General article.
I saw this writing upon the gate [of the temple], which signifies that now it is allowable to enter intellectually into the arcana of faith. TCR 508:5.
A man must not only think of the things that he does, but also of those he wills to do, which if he believes to be allowable he also does, or if not it is only for the world's sake. Explained.
He who in his own mind makes any evil allowable continually does it.
